Maximum XOR Encrypted Pair

You are a cryptographer working on a zero-knowledge proof protocol. You have an array of N secret keys. To maximize the protocol's entropy, you must find the pair of keys (A[i], A[j]) where i != j that produces the maximum XOR value.

Given an array of N non-negative integers, find the maximum XOR value achievable from any pair of elements in the array.
explanation: A Trie-based O(N log maxVal) solution. Insert all numbers into a binary trie (bit by bit from MSB to LSB). Then for each number, greedily query the trie to find the number that maximizes XOR. At each bit, try to choose the opposite bit (to set the XOR bit to 1). The maximum of all such queries is the answer.
